calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, negate its 10-session return residual versus the cross-sectional median and divide by its trailing 30-session annualized realized volatility. The signal is shifted one completed session before evaluating forward returns, avoiding look-ahead bias. Intended holding horizon is 20 trading days.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2034-06-08 available data, forward observations through 2034-05-09
validation.regime_notes: 20-day IC remained positive in 2025-2029 (+0.028736), 2030-2032 (+0.014950), and 2033-2034 (+0.031056). The 2020-2024 segment had insufficient aligned history in this data extract. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
